Who we are

More than a foundation. A movement for change.

The Sanusi Jafar Foundation is a Lagos-based charity and non-profit organisation committed to restoring hope, dignity and belonging for children, women and communities across Lagos through sustainable programmes and strategic partnerships. Our work actively supports the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) for community empowerment and poverty alleviation.

Read Our Story

Our focus

Where we make a difference in Lagos.

  • Child Welfare

    Creating safer, brighter futures for children in Lagos.

  • Women Empowerment

    Supporting women and mothers across Lagos to build stronger households and communities.

  • Youth Development

    Creating pathways for young people to learn, grow and pursue opportunities.

  • Community Outreach

    Responding to practical needs while building stronger community relationships.

Edition 4 · Dec 19

Our flagship initiative

Christmas in the Street:
Our Annual Christmas Outreach in Lagos

3 editions. 1,354+ children reached. And counting.

Every December, Christmas in the Street brings joy to children across Lagos, offers free basic health screenings for adults, and provides essential food supplies for widows and market women. Now in its fourth edition, this annual Christmas charity outreach returns on 19 December 2026 to share hope, dignity, and the joy of Christmas with families in our community.

Featured initiative

Project 1,000 Smiles

More than a number. A commitment.

Project 1,000 Smiles is a year-round initiative we’re preparing to launch for children, women, and communities in Lagos. It will carry the hope and belonging we bring every December into every month of the year.

About Project 1,000 Smiles

Our impact

Real people. Real change.

Through your support, we’re creating opportunities for women and children across Lagos, nurturing hope and helping families and communities thrive. So far, we’ve reached 1,354+ children and 273+ women.
